## Review checklist

- [ ] Read current source; distinguish implemented, proposed, and unknown.
- [ ] Preserve relevant commands, keyboard behavior, settings, and browser profiles.
- [ ] Follow architecture boundaries or document the intentional exception/ADR.
- [ ] Check cancellation, stale results, identity, or migration where affected.
- [ ] Update docs and validate local links/source references.
- [ ] Report commit/push/publish/restart separately if performed.

For docs-only changes, say so; runtime build, publish, and restart are unnecessary.
See [development guidance](../AGENTS.md) and [validation](../docs/validation.md).
